items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: I was supposed to meet him for dinner in New York the night he died.

ctx.x: That was out of question. I couldn't tell you about him. I couldn't tell you about him.

That's not Abbey the drummer that died in New York. No, no. The trumpet player. No, the trumpet player. It's his uncle or his father? His uncle. No, Abbey Brunies the drummer played. That's what he used to play with chalky.
Yeah. He took mum's place. Yeah. I was supposed to meet him for dinner in New York the night he died. No kidding.
